Introduction

Jukjae is a South Korean singer, songwriter, and producer known for his smooth and melodic style, mainly in the R&B and pop genres. He has gained popularity for his emotional ballads and collaborations with various K-pop artists. Besides his solo work, he is recognized for his skill in producing and writing songs.
